response.sql: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department, COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS member_count FROM income JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(shares.member_count) AS total_members, AVG(shares.share) AS average_share, AVG(shares.share - average_share.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE shares.share > average_share.value
